tools.description: A deterministic scenario tool. A call still running after 30 active seconds continues in the background; set background=true to start it there at once. A task runs until it exits or you stop it, unless the tool has its own time limit. To wait for a task, you can just end your turn.
tools.name: bash

background.description: start this call as a background task

forward_port.description: a fixed server TCP port to make reachable to the user when starting a background task

respawn.description: restart after each run exits; requires background; stops after 3 runs in a row each end within 2s

task_name.description: an optional name; use a single word matching [a-z0-9-]{1,10}, such as build or docs; never add a number yourself, since a repeated name is numbered automatically

tools.description: manage background tool invocations and read their live output. Restart reuses the saved tool arguments. Discard stops the task and removes its record. A completion reports its result and wakes the conversation, so end your turn to wait for a task. Never wait with sleep or by polling its status.
tools.name: task

name.description: the task name or id, except for list and prune
